phases.name: Dashboard Management API

phases.name: WebUI Iterations (superseded by Phase 29)

phases.name: WebUI Ground-Up Rebuild

phases.name: Provider Transport Layer
phases.summary: Unified transport layer (internal/provider/transport.go): per-provider Transport{baseUrl,format,headers,urlSuffix,auth} resolved at proxy time, scheme-aware auth injection (bearer/raw/query) + hook framework (kimiHeaders X-Msh-*), dual-auth (kimi OAuth x-api-key vs apikey Bearer). Refactored chat (single+combo+messages) + connection test to use it. 15 transport tests incl. mock-upstream header validation for 6 auth shapes.

phases.name: API Key Providers — Batch 2 (45)

Added devin-cli + codebuddy-intl to registry (112 total). Media registry fixes: BFL bfl.ml→bfl.ai, fal.run→queue.fal.run, stability/nebius embedding URLs, model lists synced. phases.name: OAuth Framework + Batch 1 (8 providers)
phases.summary: Token refresh engine: per-provider profiles (form/json, extra headers, error classification), singleflight dedup, per-provider lead times (codex 5d, iflow 24h). 8 providers: kimi (X-Msh-*), xai (OIDC discovery), claude (JSON), google (client_secret), qwen (resource_url), codex (unrecoverable detection), kiro (multi-path IDC/social), iflow (Basic auth). phases.name: OAuth Batch 2 + Dual-Auth (12+24)

No-refresh: kilocode/cursor/zed/windsurf. Auth hooks: clineHeaders, kilocodeOrg. Dual-auth: OAuth-preferred selection with apikey fallback. Cookie auth scheme for webCookie providers. Registry metadata: github copilot headers, codebuddy transport, cline/kilocode hooks. 12 tests.

phases.name: Security Hardening & Core Proxy Reliability Audit
phases.description: Resolve the 2026-08-12 deep-audit findings before public deployment. Full details: docs/SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-08-12.md.
tasks: 37A: secure-by-default bind/auth; redact all provider/API secrets from response DTOs; protect privileged management endpoints
37A: make login limiter race-safe and bounded; replace default password and migrate password hashing; move auth secret under configured DataDir
37B: unify single/combo/messages upstream execution; make translation, refresh, fallback classification, state persistence and usage behavior consistent
37C: implement event-correct SSE forwarding; distinguish EOF/error/cancel; split streaming timeouts; enforce request/response/multipart/header limits
37D: validate custom BaseURL and panel-url against SSRF/redirect policy; make panel extraction and sensitive config writes atomic and permission-safe
37E: add regression/E2E coverage, then run go fmt ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./..., go test -race ./... and vulnerability scanning
phases.notes: Static audit recorded 2026-08-12. P0 blockers: default 0.0.0.0 + unauthenticated management API, plaintext provider secrets returned by API, race-prone login limiter, weak/default password design. Dynamic verification was blocked in the audit environment because Go was unavailable; do not mark done until race/vet/E2E gates pass.
